method: Applied each fresh-review finding after checking the cited inventory, ToolsView, CDP handler and CDP client sources. Source-only proposal correction; no tests, browser, database, permission changes, build or runtime execution.

findings.independent_finding_verbatim: CORRECT: positive and schema-negative are source-aligned. Add a failure path if debugger attach succeeds but Network.enable rejects: start returns ok:false while attachment may remain; inspect only the verified owned tab and clean it up if it is the unique owned delta. Do not leave a known owned debugger attachment behind under the generic ambiguity rule.
findings.proposal_change: Added a shared conditional failure cleanup: if start returns an error, compare the attachment list to baseline and detach only a unique new delta equal to this run's exact owned target ID; do nothing when there is no delta and never detach an ambiguous ID.

findings.independent_finding_verbatim: CORRECT: put max=0 and max=2001 schema negatives after records are queued but before the valid drain; compare pre/post queue by the subsequent valid drain. The current after-drain negatives cannot prove records survived rejection. Keep the no-filter rule: filtering happens after splice and discards filtered-out records.
findings.proposal_change: Moved each invalid max call ahead of a valid drain. Each negative is preceded by a completed load of the owned public target and followed by a valid drain that requires records from that load; the second max boundary gets a separate reload and preservation check. The procedure still avoids url_contains because filtering follows destructive splice.

findings.independent_finding_verbatim: CORRECT: place invalid string tab_id while capture is active and before first stop; establish a completed queued request before it, then drain and confirm it survived rejection before stopping. The current negative after detach cannot prove capture stayed active. The later repeated stop and post-stop empty drain are valid.
findings.proposal_change: Moved invalid stop schema input before valid stop/detach. The following valid drain must return queued records, then a second page reload and drain must show capture continued after rejection. No records means the negative-state proof is unresolved. Preserved valid stop, post-stop empty drain, repeated stop and explicit attachment cleanup.

findings.independent_finding_verbatim: CORRECT: response-body API and request-ID provenance are right. Revise the privacy/evidence instruction: the manual runner renders JSON output containing body and broadcasts the full output on TOOL_TIMELINE_EVENT. Confine execution to the public owned target; record only safe metadata in durable evidence. A public POST/request-body fixture is not required for this case. Retain observed failure as failure/fixture gap rather than claiming success.
findings.proposal_change: Acknowledged that the runner renders and broadcasts the full response body. The procedure uses only the owned public example.org target, permits transient visible body output, and prohibits copying body text/screenshots into evidence. Removed the irrelevant POST/request-body fixture blocker and retained exact drained request_id provenance plus observed failure/setup-gap handling.

findings.independent_finding_verbatim: The inventory readiness gap explicitly calls for gated/negative permission cases, but the shared setup treats absent debugger permission as unavailable/not run. Since the manual runner directly invokes handler.run, schema negatives cannot prove dispatcher permission enforcement. Add a separately scoped authorized permission-negative procedure, or keep these inventory cells incomplete and explicitly identify that pending case; do not present the four proposals as exhaustive permission coverage.
findings.proposal_change: Kept the four-case scope and status runtime-unverified. Explicitly states permission-denial enforcement remains pending for all four cases and requires a separate dispatcher-path procedure; no permission is changed and no coverage/pass claim is made.

unresolved_boundaries: Debugger permission-denial and dispatcher enforcement remain unverified for these inventory cases; the manual runner bypasses this gate. A separate dispatcher-path procedure is pending.
No browser, build, tests, database, runtime receipt or live outcome was performed or verified.
If the public page does not produce queued completed records after a reload, the drain/stop preservation assertion remains unverified rather than passing on an empty queue.
